description: Four slow envelopes that switch themselves on and off: a shared timer marks out the gaps, each lane rolls its own chance of firing at one, and each fades up and down over seconds to drive a VCA

params.text: Sets how long the gaps between events last, 90 seconds at the counter-clockwise end and 5 seconds at the clockwise end on a logarithmic scale; a cable in the Density CV input takes it out of use
Varies the length of each gap at random, by nothing at the counter-clockwise end and by up to 30% either way at the clockwise end
Varies how long each event runs at random, by nothing at the counter-clockwise end and by up to half either way at the clockwise end
On starts the enabled lane with the highest Weight whenever no lane is running, so the module never falls silent; its lamp is white while this is on and red while it is off
Each press switches that lane on or off; a lane switched off holds its output at 0V whatever its Floor knob says, and its lamp turns red
Sets the chance that this lane fires when a gap ends, from never at the counter-clockwise end to every time at the clockwise end
Sets how long this lane stays on once it fires, 5 seconds at the counter-clockwise end and 90 seconds at the clockwise end on a logarithmic scale, and its fade times are taken from it too
Sets the level this lane rests at between events, 0V at the counter-clockwise end and the full 5V at the clockwise end, with the envelope rising from there

inputs.text: Sets the gap length outright, 0V giving 90 seconds and 10V giving 5 seconds; while a cable is here the Density knob is left out of the reckoning
A rising edge past 1V switches that lane on for a full duration with its jitter, even while it is already running; the lane's enable button has to be on for this to reach it

outputs.text: That lane's envelope, 0V to 5V, rising and falling on one-pole curves whose times come from its Duration knob and resting at the level its Floor knob sets

notes: this module works on a scale of seconds to minutes: gaps of 5 to 90 seconds, events of 5 to 90 seconds and fades measured in seconds, so a patch takes a while to show what it does
a lane's attack is a fifth of its Duration setting held between 30ms and 2 seconds, and its release is two fifths of it held between 300ms and 25 seconds
a lane's lamp is red while that lane is switched off and white while it is on, its brightness following the envelope that lane is putting out
the four enable buttons are saved with the patch, and nothing else about the module's state is, so the gaps and the events start afresh each time it is loaded
